deficits.evidence: footway is under 1m and partly blocked by obstructions
deficits.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk at least 1m wide along the left side of the road.

deficits.evidence: obstruction by parked vehicles and other items on the footway
deficits.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure the footway is clear for pedestrian use.

deficits.evidence: uneven and broken sections on the footway
deficits.suggestion: Repair and resurface the footway to eliminate trip hazards.

deficits.evidence: marked crossing without refuge on a wide road
deficits.suggestion: Add a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: crossing is hard to see and obstructed
deficits.suggestion: Improve visibility of the crossing with better markings and signage, and ensure it is not obstructed by vehicles or other items.

deficits.evidence: no dropped kerbs at the crossing
deficits.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to facilitate safe pedestrian access.

ratings.reason: The left side has a very narrow, fragmented verge rather than a proper footway.
Vegetation and poles obstruct the narrow pedestrian area on the left.
The resolution is too low to definitively identify specific trip hazards or broken pavement.
The road is wide and the zebra crossing lacks a central refuge island.
The crossing markings are faded and often obscured by turning vehicles.
The angle of the frames does not clearly show the kerb edge at the crossing points.
